title: Uniswap Foundation Security Fund (UFSF) Audit Subsidies
description: Up to 100% subsidy on smart contract audit costs for projects building in the Uniswap ecosystem, including Uniswap v4 hooks and Uniswap Trading API integrations. Run by Areta in monthly cohorts, with a pre-audit security scan and competing quotes from a curated auditor marketplace.
reward: Up to 100% subsidy on audit costs, plus a pre-audit security scan and access to the Areta auditor marketplace
summary: up to 100% audit subsidy · monthly cohorts close the 7th, 23:59 UTC

eligibility.note: smart contracts in the Uniswap ecosystem (a v4 hook or a Uniswap integration) with a date they will be ready for audit

ideas: A Uniswap v4 hook ready for its audit
A trading app built on the Uniswap Trading API
A DeFi protocol integrating Uniswap liquidity
setup: a registered legal entity for KYB
contracts finalized and ready for audit
each_time: lines of code to audit and a ready-by date
TVL, monthly users and transaction counts
rules: Monthly cohorts: applications close on the 7th of each month at 23:59 UTC. A late application automatically enters next month's cohort; the form stays open year-round.
Only projects building in the Uniswap ecosystem are eligible, including Uniswap v4 hooks and Uniswap Trading API integrations.
Selected projects get a pre-audit security scan, up to 100% subsidy on audit costs, and the Areta auditor marketplace with competing quotes.
The audit must begin within 30 days of subsidy approval. If the subsidy does not cover 100% of the cost, you pay the rest.
Delays past the date you give for audit-ready contracts may revoke the subsidy.
Each project can apply at most 3 times in total; carrying an application forward to the next cohort counts toward the cap.
The applicant confirms it is a registered legal entity; KYB documents are needed after a positive decision, and a Grant Agreement may be required.
The form asks the applicant to accept the Head Agreement and Application Conditions.
